name: MapLabels
description: 3D roads and labels: place names, road names and freeway lines from OpenMapTiles vector tiles, drawn upright over terrain and 3D Tiles on the Cesium globe. Globe only.

supportedData.label: OpenMapTiles vector tiles
supportedData.description: Vector tiles in the OpenMapTiles schema; the place, transportation_name and transportation layers are used. A TileJSON URL is read at start-up for the current tile URL.
supportedData.procurement: OpenFreeMap (https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet) is free and needs no key. Any OpenMapTiles-schema tile server works.

components.name: Layer Name
components.description: A display name for the layer.

components.name: Initial Visibility
components.description: Whether the layer is on initially.

components.name: Vector Tiles URL
components.description: A TileJSON URL, or a {z}/{x}/{y}.pbf URL, for OpenMapTiles-schema vector tiles. Leave empty for OpenFreeMap (https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet).

components.name: Place Names
components.description: Cities, towns, suburbs and neighbourhoods; smaller places appear as you zoom in.

components.name: Road Names
components.description: Freeway route numbers from mid zoom; street names up close.

components.name: Major Road Lines
components.description: Freeways as lines draped on the ground.

components.name: Label Size (px)
components.description: Base label size in pixels. Default 14.
